about: BLS International Services Limited provides outsourcing and administrative task of visa, passport, and consular services to various diplomatic missions in India. It operates through the Rendering of Visa and other Allied Services, and Digital Services segments. The company offers citizen and front-end services; consular services; e-visa; biometric and identity management services; verification and attestation services; and value-added services, such as courier, domestic money transfer, and Aadha
